en.android-client.intro: This chapter explains the usage scope, system interaction, account and network service boundaries of ModelNex.AI Android client. The specific available functions are subject to the current officially released version, account rights and client interface.
en.android-client.blocks.1.text: The Android client is oriented to scenarios such as account login, official node connection, user-defined nodes, subscription and traffic viewing, card packages, diagnostic support, and account security settings on mobile devices. The client establishes a local network tunnel through the VPN capabilities provided by the Android system, and handles related network connections after obtaining user authorization.
en.android-client.blocks.2.text: The client does not replace the Android system, carrier, or third-party network services. Whether the connection can be established and the final access effect are still affected by the device system version, network environment, node status, protocol compatibility and server authorization status.
en.android-client.blocks.3.text: Operational structure and boundaries of responsibility
en.android-client.blocks.4.title: Android client connection link
en.android-client.blocks.4.nodes.1: Coordinate local status with system permissions
en.android-client.blocks.4.nodes.2: Authenticated account, rights and node information
en.android-client.blocks.5.text: The interface layer is responsible for displaying account, node, connection and setting status; the client local layer is responsible for saving necessary local state and coordinating system permissions; the authenticated service interface provides account rights, available nodes and service status; the Android system is responsible for establishing and managing device-level VPN connections. Custom nodes are provided by users and cannot be considered official nodes due to import into the client.
en.android-client.blocks.7.text: Android installation packages or updates should only be obtained from ModelNex.AI official distribution channels. The application name, release source and version information should be checked before installation; the client should not be installed from chat records, network disks, web images or modified installation packages from unknown sources.
en.android-client.blocks.8.text: Client updates may include protocol compatibility adjustments, account interface updates, or security fixes. For versions marked as important or mandatory updates, older versions may no longer be able to use some online capabilities. Updates will not ask users to provide passwords, verification codes, recovery phrases, or private keys through customer service, chat, or unofficial web pages.
en.android-client.blocks.9.text: First time use and system authorization
en.android-client.blocks.10.items.0: Log in or register a ModelNex.AI account and complete the identity verification required by the current interface;
en.android-client.blocks.10.items.1: Select an available official node on the node page, or import a custom node in the format supported by the client;
en.android-client.blocks.10.items.2: When connecting for the first time, confirm VPN connection authorization in the Android system pop-up window;
en.android-client.blocks.10.items.3: Confirm the current connection status, node information and account equity status before using network services;
en.android-client.blocks.10.items.4: If the system has been taken over by other VPN, firewall, device management or security software, please check its compatibility first.
en.android-client.blocks.11.text: Android typically only allows one device-level VPN service to be active at the same time. Other VPNs, some network security software, work profile management, or device policies may prevent ModelNex.AI from establishing a connection or change network behavior during a connection.
en.android-client.blocks.13.rows.0.1: The device-level VPN tunnel has not been established.
en.android-client.blocks.13.rows.0.2: Check the account, node, and local network before initiating the connection.
en.android-client.blocks.13.rows.1.1: The client is requesting authorization or establishing a connection to the selected node.
en.android-client.blocks.13.rows.1.2: Keep the front page to avoid repeated connection initiation.
en.android-client.blocks.13.rows.2.1: Android VPN service is already active.
en.android-client.blocks.13.rows.2.2: You can view the current status of nodes, duration and traffic.
en.android-client.blocks.13.rows.3.1: The connection was interrupted by system, network, node, or authentication status.
en.android-client.blocks.13.rows.3.2: Check error messages, network and node status before trying again.
en.android-client.blocks.13.rows.4.1: The client has stopped the native VPN service.
en.android-client.blocks.13.rows.4.2: Re-select nodes and connect if necessary.
en.android-client.blocks.14.text: Connection interruptions may occur due to mobile networks, Wi-Fi switching, power saving policies, system background limitations, or node maintenance. Automatic reconnection or background behavior is subject to the settings of the currently released version and the behavior actually allowed by the Android system.
en.android-client.blocks.16.text: Account rights and interests are subject to the certified server status. Subscription traffic, separate purchase traffic, validity period, speed limit policy and available nodes belong to different equity fields, and the client should display them separately, and any one of them cannot be replaced by another incorrectly.
en.android-client.blocks.17.text: Card packs are used to display issued benefit cards and their available status. Only cards marked by the server as applicable on the client can perform corresponding operations on the client; cards for discounts, payments, or cards only used for website settlement should be used in the corresponding settlement process instead of directly modifying client rights.
en.android-client.blocks.18.text: Account, subscription, traffic and card package changes rely on online service synchronization. The client may need to refresh when the network is unstable or when the operation has just been completed. The final status is subject to the confirmation result of the server.
en.android-client.blocks.20.text: The visibility range of official nodes is determined by account permissions, service status and client version. The reachability or latency displayed on the node page is status information and does not constitute a commitment to fixed speeds, fixed latency, or continuous availability.
en.android-client.blocks.21.text: Users can import custom nodes that have legally obtained usage rights within the scope supported by the client. The address, authentication materials, traffic, bandwidth, security and legal compliance of the custom node are the responsibility of the user or the corresponding resource provider. Private keys, passwords, tokens, API keys, and other access credentials should be removed before importing, exporting, taking screenshots, or sharing configurations.
en.android-client.blocks.23.text: Notification permissions are used to display information to users about account or client status. Users can manage notification permissions in Android system settings and client settings; turning off notifications will not automatically change account rights, but you may not be able to receive timely updates, services or security prompts.
en.android-client.blocks.24.text: Diagnostic logs, feedback and customer service conversations are used by users to proactively seek support. Text, images, and configurations should be checked for unnecessary sensitive data before submission. Clients should not send a user's private key, password, verification code, or full custom node credentials as normal support content unless explicitly submitted by the user in the current function.
en.android-client.blocks.26.items.0: Use a unique and strong account password and enable available authentication protections per account settings;
en.android-client.blocks.26.items.1: Do not provide login passwords, one-time verification codes, card security information, private keys or recovery materials to anyone;
en.android-client.blocks.26.items.2: Log out of your account and remove local sensitive configurations before selling, transferring, or repairing equipment;
en.android-client.blocks.26.items.3: Install Android system updates and official client security updates in a timely manner;
en.android-client.blocks.26.items.4: When encountering unknown logins, abnormal nodes, or suspicious notifications, first change the password and end the unknown session in the device management.
en.android-client.blocks.28.rows.0.1: Network availability, account login status, Android VPN authorization, and presence of another active VPN.
en.android-client.blocks.28.rows.1.1: Node status, current network restrictions, DNS settings, system private DNS or other security software.
en.android-client.blocks.28.rows.2.1: Wi-Fi and mobile network switching, battery optimization, background throttling, node maintenance and network quality.
en.android-client.blocks.28.rows.3.0: Benefits or card packs are not updated
en.android-client.blocks.28.rows.3.1: Refresh the account status; confirm that the operation has been completed by the server and the same account is used.
en.android-client.blocks.29.text: If the problem persists, you can submit brief reproduction steps, occurrence time, client version and non-sensitive diagnostic information through the client support portal. Do not write account passwords, one-time verification codes, private keys or complete authentication configurations into work orders or customer service messages.
en.cross-platform-features.intro: This chapter explains ModelNex.AI’s unified account rules, synchronization range, and platform differences between different clients. Currently, only the functions that have been officially released and displayed in the corresponding version are described; the specific capabilities of the unreleased platform shall be subject to its subsequent official documents.
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.1.text: ModelNex.AI uses a unified account system. Users can log in to the same account on a supported platform and obtain the subscription, traffic, official node permissions and card package status corresponding to the account after confirmation on the server. Account unification does not mean that all platforms have the same interface, network permissions, protocol implementation, backend capabilities or system integration methods.
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.2.text: The cross-platform design is based on the principle of "centralized confirmation of account rights, independent management of local connections, and user control of sensitive configurations." The client cannot treat the online connection status, system permissions, or local network settings of other devices as the true status of the current device.
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.4.title: cross-platform information flow
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.4.nodes.0: Users log in to the same account on any official client
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.4.nodes.1: Authentication service confirms accounts, rights and available services
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.4.nodes.2: The client obtains the node and account status that can be displayed locally
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.4.nodes.3: Each device independently requests local system VPN permissions and establishes a connection
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.4.nodes.4: Local connections, network permissions and diagnostic status are saved independently
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.5.text: Account-level information is subject to the certified server confirmation results; device-level information is subject to the local client and operating system. This division prevents network status, permissions, or error messages from one device from incorrectly overwriting other devices.
The results of account authentication and server confirmation shall prevail.
Equity is calculated by the server; the client displays each equity category separately.
Official node directory and service status
Clients are displayed according to account permissions and current service status.
Connection, disconnection, and system authorization for each device are not interchangeable.
Granted, revoked and restricted by the corresponding operating system.
Cross-device replication should not be assumed unless the product explicitly provides a synchronization option.
Import, export, or synchronization should be initiated by the user and should not propagate sensitive credentials by default.
The corresponding support process will only be entered when the user chooses to submit.
Android VPN authorization, mobile network and background restriction rules apply.
Specific installation, network permissions, and functionality instructions will be provided after official release.
Specific distribution, desktop integration, and network service instructions will be provided after general release.
Installation, command, configuration, and device compatibility instructions will be provided after general release.
Network permissions and client instructions for Apple platforms will be available upon general release.
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.10.text: "Under development" only means that the public client documentation for the platform has not yet been completed. It does not mean that the platform has committed to a launch date, functional scope, or an implementation that is completely consistent with Android.
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.12.text: Subscription benefits, subscription traffic, separately purchased traffic and service limitations should be treated as independent information. The client can display these fields separately on the account page, but must not infer the balance, validity period or rate limiting policy of other fields just because a certain field exists or is empty.
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.13.text: When a user purchases services, redeems benefits, or applies available cards on a certain device, other logged-in clients should display the same account-level results after completing the refresh and server confirmation. The network connection itself is still established individually by each device and does not automatically connect because another device is connected.
Do not transfer account passwords, one-time verification codes, private keys, Tokens or API Keys between devices through customer service, work orders or unofficial channels;
Do not default to a custom node configuration exported by one device as a configuration that is safe for use by another device;

The exit operation in device management is used to end the account session of the corresponding device and is not equivalent to clearing the data saved by other applications in the device's operating system;
When replacing a device, selling a device, or discovering an abnormal session, you should log out of your account, update your password, and review the logged-in device;
Always use clients provided by official release channels and avoid entering account or node credentials into unverified builds.
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.17.text: Different platforms may receive feature, protocol, or security updates at different times. The server interface will determine whether older versions can still access certain online features based on compatibility and security requirements. When the client version lags behind, users should upgrade according to official update prompts and should not bypass compatibility checks by modifying requests or replacing internal components.
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.18.text: Functional differences should be subject to official updates in the corresponding platform client page, release notes, and this section. Internal interfaces, testing capabilities, or management capabilities that do not appear in public documentation or current clients should not be considered a cross-platform commitment to users.
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.20.rows.0: One device displays benefits differently than another
Refresh the account status respectively, confirm that the two devices use the same account, and wait for the server operation to complete.
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.20.rows.1: One device can connect, the other cannot
Check the device's system VPN authorization, network environment, version, node permissions, and native security software individually.
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.20.rows.2: The device list does not match actual use
Check recent activity information in Account Device Management and end sessions you don't recognize or no longer use.
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.20.rows.3: Settings cannot be reproduced across devices
First confirm whether the setting belongs to the local network, system permissions or local preferences. It should not be assumed that it will be synchronized by default.
en.cross-platform-features.blocks.21.text: When requesting support, please indicate the affected platform, client version, time of occurrence, account operation results and non-sensitive error information. Cross-platform questions should avoid submitting passwords, verification codes, private keys, full node authentication configurations, or other unnecessary credentials.

zh-TW.android-client.intro: 本章說明 ModelNex.AI Android 用戶端的使用範圍、系統互動、帳戶與網路服務邊界。具體可用功能以目前正式發布版本、帳戶權益及客戶端介面為準。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.1.text: Android 用戶端則是針對行動裝置上的帳號登入、官方節點連線、使用者自訂節點、訂閱與流量檢視、卡片包、診斷支援和帳號安全設定等場景。用戶端透過 Android 系統提供的 VPN 能力建立本機網路隧道，並在經過使用者授權後處理相關網路連線。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.2.text: 客戶端不取代 Android 系統、電信業者或第三方網路服務。是否能夠建立連線及最終存取效果，仍受裝置系統版本、網路環境、節點狀態、協定相容性及服務端授權狀態影響。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.4.title: Android 用戶端的連線連結
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.4.nodes.0: 使用者介面與帳戶操作
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.4.nodes.1: 本地狀態與系統權限協調
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.4.nodes.2: 認證後的帳戶、權益與節點訊息
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.4.nodes.4: 已選擇的官方或自訂節點
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.5.text: 介面層負責展示帳戶、節點、連線和設定狀態；用戶端本地層負責保存必要的本機狀態並協調系統權限；經認證的服務介面提供帳戶權益、可用節點和服務狀態；Android 系統負責建立和管理裝置級 VPN 連線。自訂節點由使用者提供，不能因導入客戶端而視為官方節點。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.7.text: 應僅從 ModelNex.AI 官方發布管道取得 Android 安裝套件或更新。安裝前應核對應用程式名稱、發布來源和版本資訊；不應從來源不明的聊天記錄、網盤、網頁鏡像或修改版安裝包安裝用戶端。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.8.text: 客戶端更新可能包含協定相容性調整、帳戶介面更新或安全性修復。對於被標記為重要或強制更新的版本，舊版本可能無法繼續使用部分線上能力。更新不會要求使用者透過客服、聊天或非官方網頁提供密碼、驗證碼、恢復短語或私鑰。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.10.items.0: 登入或註冊 ModelNex.AI 帳戶，並完成目前介面要求的身份驗證；
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.10.items.1: 在節點頁面選擇可使用的官方節點，或依客戶端支援的格式匯入自訂節點；
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.10.items.2: 首次連線時，在 Android 系統彈跳窗中確認 VPN 連線授權；
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.10.items.3: 確認目前連線狀態、節點資訊及帳戶權益狀態後再使用網路服務；
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.10.items.4: 如係統已由其他 VPN、防火牆、裝置管理或安全軟體接管網絡，請先核對其相容性。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.11.text: Android 通常只允許一個裝置級 VPN 服務同時處於作用中狀態。其他 VPN、部分網路安全軟體、工作資料管理或裝置策略可能會阻止 ModelNex.AI 建立連接，或在連接期間變更網路行為。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.13.rows.0.1: 尚未建立設備級 VPN 隧道。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.13.rows.0.2: 檢查帳戶、節點和本地網路後發起連線。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.13.rows.1.1: 客戶端正在請求授權或建立到所選節點的連線。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.13.rows.1.2: 保留前台頁面，避免重複發起連線。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.13.rows.2.1: Android VPN 服務已處於活動狀態。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.13.rows.2.2: 可查看節點、時長和流量等目前狀態。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.13.rows.3.1: 連線被系統、網路、節點或認證狀態中斷。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.13.rows.3.2: 檢查錯誤訊息、網路與節點狀態後再嘗試。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.13.rows.4.1: 用戶端已停止本機 VPN 服務。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.13.rows.4.2: 需要時重新選擇節點並連接。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.14.text: 行動網路、Wi-Fi 切換、省電策略、系統後台限製或節點維護可能造成連線中斷。自動重連或後台行為以目前發布版本的設定項目和 Android 系統實際允許的行為為準。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.16.text: 帳戶權益以經過認證的服務端狀態為準。訂閱流量、單獨購買流量、有效期、限速策略和可用節點屬於不同的權益字段，客戶端應分別展示，不能將其中任一項錯誤替代為另一項。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.17.text: 卡包用於展示已發放的權益卡和其可用狀態。只有被服務端標記為可在客戶端應用的卡，才可在客戶端執行相應操作；折扣、支付或僅用於網站結算的卡應在對應結算流程使用，而不是直接修改客戶端權益。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.18.text: 帳戶、訂閱、流量和卡包變更依賴線上服務同步。客戶端在網路不穩定或剛完成操作時可能需要刷新，最終狀態以服務端確認結果為準。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.20.text: 官方節點的可見範圍由帳戶權限、服務狀態和客戶端版本共同決定。節點頁面顯示的可及性或延遲屬於狀態訊息，不構成固定速度、固定延遲或持續可用性的承諾。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.21.text: 使用者可在用戶端支援的範圍內匯入合法取得使用權的自訂節點。自訂節點的位址、認證材料、流量、頻寬、安全性和法律合規性由使用者或相應資源提供者負責。匯入、匯出、截圖或分享設定前，應移除私鑰、密碼、Token、API Key 和其他存取憑證。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.23.text: 通知權限用於向使用者顯示與帳戶或用戶端狀態相關的資訊。使用者可在 Android 系統設定及用戶端設定中管理通知權限；關閉通知不會自動改變帳戶權益，但可能無法及時收到更新、服務或安全性提示。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.24.text: 診斷日誌、回饋和客服對話用於使用者主動尋求支援。提交前應檢查文字、圖片和配置中是否包含不必要的敏感資料。除非使用者在目前功能中明確提交，客戶端不應將使用者的私鑰、密碼、驗證碼或完整自訂節點憑證作為普通支援內容發送。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.26.items.0: 使用唯一且強度足夠的帳戶密碼，並按帳戶設定啟用可用的身份驗證保護；
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.26.items.1: 不要向任何人提供登入密碼、一次性驗證碼、卡片安全資訊、私鑰或恢復資料；
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.26.items.2: 在出售、轉交或維修設備前退出帳戶並移除本地敏感配置；
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.26.items.3: 及時安裝 Android 系統更新與官方客戶端安全更新；
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.26.items.4: 遇到未知登入、異常節點或可疑通知時，先修改密碼並在裝置管理中結束不認識的會話。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.28.rows.0.1: 網路可用性、帳號登入狀態、Android VPN 授權和是否存在另一項活動 VPN。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.28.rows.1.1: 節點狀態、目前網路限制、DNS 設定、系統私有 DNS 或其他安全軟體。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.28.rows.2.1: Wi-Fi 與行動網路切換、電池優化、後台限制、節點維護和網路品質。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.28.rows.3.1: 重新整理帳戶狀態；確認作業已由服務端完成且使用的是相同帳戶。
zh-TW.android-client.blocks.29.text: 如問題持續存在，可透過客戶端支援入口提交簡要復現步驟、發生時間、客戶端版本和非敏感診斷資訊。請勿將帳戶密碼、一次性驗證碼、私鑰或完整認證配置寫入工單或客服訊息。
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.intro: 本章說明 ModelNex.AI 在不同客戶端之間的統一帳戶規則、可同步範圍與平台差異。目前僅對已正式發布並在相應版本中顯示的功能作說明；未發布平台的具體能力以其後續正式文件為準。
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.1.text: ModelNex.AI 使用統一帳戶系統。使用者可在受支援平台登入相同帳戶，並在服務端確認後取得該帳戶對應的訂閱、流量、官方節點權限及卡片包狀態。帳戶統一不代表所有平台具有相同的介面、網路權限、協定實現、後台能力或系統整合方式。
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.2.text: 跨平台設計以「帳戶權益集中確認、本機連接獨立管理、敏感配置由使用者控制」為原則。客戶端不能把其他裝置的線上連線狀態、系統權限或本地網路設定當作目前裝置的真實狀態。
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.4.title: 跨平台資訊流
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.4.nodes.0: 用戶在任一正式客戶端登入相同帳戶
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.4.nodes.1: 認證服務確認帳戶、權益與可用服務
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.4.nodes.2: 用戶端取得本機可展示的節點與帳戶狀態
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.4.nodes.3: 每台設備分別請求本機系統 VPN 權限並建立連接
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.4.nodes.4: 本機連線、網路權限與診斷狀態獨立保存
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.5.text: 帳戶級資訊以經過認證的服務端確認結果為準；設備級資訊則以本機用戶端和作業系統為準。此劃分避免一台設備的網路狀態、權限或錯誤訊息錯誤覆蓋其他設備。
以帳戶認證和服務端確認結果為準。
權益由服務端計算；客戶端分別展示各權益類別。
官方節點目錄與服務狀態
客戶端按帳戶權限和目前服務狀態展示。
每台設備的連接、斷開和系統授權互不取代。
系統 VPN 與通知權限
由對應作業系統授予、撤銷和限制。
除非產品明確提供同步選項，否則不應假定跨裝置複製。
匯入、匯出或同步應由使用者主動發起，不應預設傳播敏感憑證。
僅在使用者選擇提交時進入對應支援流程。
適用 Android 系統 VPN 授權、行動網路和後台限制規則。
具體安裝、網路權限和功能說明將在正式發布後提供。
具體發行版、桌面整合和網路服務說明將在正式發布後提供。
安裝、命令、配置和設備相容性說明將在正式發布後提供。
Apple 平台的網路權限與用戶端說明將在正式發布後提供。
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.10.text: 「正在開發中」僅表示該平台的公開用戶端文件尚未完成，不代表該平台已承諾上線日期、功能範圍或與 Android 完全一致的實作。
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.12.text: 訂閱權益、訂閱流量、單獨購買流量及服務限制應作為獨立資訊處理。客戶端可以在帳戶頁面分別展示這些字段，但不得因為某一字段存在或為空而推斷其他字段的餘額、有效期或限速策略。
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.13.text: 當使用者在某一裝置購買服務、兌換權益或應用程式可用卡片後，其他已登入用戶端在完成刷新和服務端確認後應顯示相同的帳戶級結果。網路連線本身仍由每台裝置分別建立，不會因為另一台裝置已連線而自動連線。
不要將帳戶密碼、一次性驗證碼、私鑰、Token 或 API Key 透過客服、工單或非官方管道在裝置之間傳遞；
不要將一台設備匯出的自訂節點配置預設視為另一台設備可以安全使用的配置；
設備管理中的退出操作用於結束對應設備的帳戶會話，不等同於清除該設備作業系統中其他應用程式保存的資料；
更換設備、出售設備或發現異常會話時，應登出帳戶、更新密碼並複查已登入設備；
請務必使用官方發布管道提供的用戶端，避免在未經驗證的建置版本中輸入帳戶或節點憑證。
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.17.text: 不同平台可能在不同時間接收功能、協定或安全性更新。服務端介面會以相容性和安全性要求決定舊版本是否仍可存取特定線上功能。當客戶端版本落後時，使用者應按照官方更新提示升級，而不應透過修改請求或替換內部元件繞過相容性檢查。
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.18.text: 功能差異應以對應平台用戶端頁面、發布說明和本章節中的正式更新為準。沒有在公開文件或目前用戶端中出現的內部介面、測試能力或管理功能，不應視為面向使用者的跨平台承諾。
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.20.rows.0: 一台設備顯示的權益與另一台不同
分別重新整理帳戶狀態，確認兩台裝置使用的是同一帳戶，並等待服務端作業完成。
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.20.rows.1: 一台設備能連接、另一台不能
分別檢查該設備的系統 VPN 授權、網路環境、版本、節點權限及本機安全軟體。
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.20.rows.2: 設備清單與實際使用不符
在帳戶設備管理中核對最近活動訊息，並結束不認識或不再使用的會話。
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.20.rows.3: 先確認該設定是否屬於本機網路、系統權限或本地偏好，不應預設認為其會同步。
zh-TW.cross-platform-features.blocks.21.text: 需要支援時，請說明受影響的平台、客戶端版本、發生時間、帳戶操作結果和非敏感錯誤訊息。跨平台問題應避免提交密碼、驗證碼、私密金鑰、完整節點認證配置或其他不必要的憑證。
